<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY ent 'resolved-entity'>">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NATION png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Parent comment block with entity &ent; reference -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1" xlink:type="simple">
    <?sub-pi target="process" data="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &ent;, and other data.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Entity">
  <!ENTITY beta "α and Beta">
  <!ENTITY % ext_pe SYSTEM "http://localhost/external.dtd">
  %ext_pe;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:m="http://schemas.microsoft.com/ado/2007/08/dataservices/metadata">
  <!-- Top level comment covering metadata namespace -->
  <m:item m:type="String">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed content block #2 with β usage.
    ]]>
  </m:item>
  <item>β</item>
</catalog>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY rawfile SYSTEM "notes.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="test"?>
<document xmlns="urn:document:base" xmlns:x="urn:document:x" xmlns:y="urn:document:y">
  <!-- Comment in root with namespace prefixes -->
  <x:section x:attr="val1">
    <?x-process action="verify"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with markup like <section> and entity &ent2;.
    ]]>
  </x:section>
  <y:section>&ent2;</y:section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % local_macro "<!ENTITY macro_ent 'Macro Expanded'>">
  %local_macro;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc_sys SYSTEM "doc.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" title="Compact"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/ns/store">
  <!-- Inventory tracking comment block -->
  <store:stock store:code="A99">
    <?store-action type="audit"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Special CDATA section: &macro_ent; inside unparsed zone.
    ]]>
  </store:stock>
  <stock>&macro_ent;</stock>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base_ent "Base Value">
  <!ENTITY ref_ent "Reference to: &base_ent;">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_subset "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd_subset;
]>
<?xml-timestamp value="2023-10-25"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Archive header comment -->
  <meta:record meta:status="active" xlink:type="simple">
    <?meta-control command="index"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Archive CDATA block containing &ref_ent; and tags <record>.
    ]]>
  </meta:record>
  <record>&ref_ent;</record>
</archive>
